card.name: Start of rare disease names
card.fires_on: The word or word start just before a rare disease or condition name is completed, such as 'por' before phyria, 'angi' before opathy, or 'with' before a named disease. It appears in lists of conditions and contraindications.

modes.label: Start of long disease name
modes.description: First piece of a long medical condition name, like porphyria or microangiopathy, with the rest still to come.

modes.label: Link before a named disease
modes.description: A small linking word right before a specific disease is named.
modes.example: to treat chorea associated<< with>> Huntington’s disease (HD) is determined

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the rare disease or condition name that follows.
card.plain: It fires when a rare disease name is just starting, such as the first part of porphyria, or the word leading into one.
